title: Catalogue entry (catalogue/*.json)
description: One entry of a ruleset's catalogue, one file each under catalogue/: a thing of one of the forms ruleset.json declares, with the values it carries for the number properties that form lists. See internal/rules/load.go for the authoritative loader; this document is the external contract for ruleset authors and is cross-checked against loader behavior by internal/rules/schema_test.go.

id.description: The entry's id; no other entry, ability or condition of the ruleset declares it. At most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

name.description: The entry's display name: what the table calls it.

description.description: What the entry is at the table, for a player and for the agent.

form.description: The key of the form, among those ruleset.json declares, that the entry is of.

extends.description: Optional. The id of another entry of the same form, which this one extends: it holds every value of that entry, after that entry's own extends, that it does not set itself. Never empty, never an id the catalogue does not hold, and never a cycle of entries extending each other.

values.description: Optional. The entry's value for each property it carries, keyed by the property's key, which its form lists: an integer within a 32-bit signed integer, never null. An entry need not carry every property its form lists, and holds no value for one it neither carries nor inherits through extends.
